title: Reading Drill — Checking a portable exhibition ramp — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Checking a portable exhibition ramp — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Brackenton began with reports of visitors slowing down at the top of the ramp. The event access volunteer had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using observations at each entrance and chose time to enter the room as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a level resting area. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted nine weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded the weight of peoples' bags as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
